title: Audit typed-echo to selected-centre recursive cost transfer
body:
PR2464’s 112-primitive typed-echo saving is valid, but its proposed deletion of eight rank-eight recursive children per pair is an additional compiler premise. This audit separates the two: 48 saved primitives are source shears, 64 are frame boundaries, and both schedules retain the same forward/inverse typed children.

The written proof shows equal recursive histograms under every fixed additive nonnegative tariff on those children. A concrete countermodel has 16 rank-eight calls before and after fusion while retaining the exact scalar saving. This disproves inference from the typed contract alone; it is neither a native impossibility result nor a counterexample to the echo. PR2464’s explicit no-admission/no-new-kappa disclaimer remains appropriate. The package specifies the missing native source/sink, child, restoration, and complete-cost correspondence.

Sources: PR2464 at `f364b97ff4700147fc06e622b79952b9fe6c4fa8`; canonical base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision4. Credit Aaron Wang’s conditional-pricing audit, Cinna Davis’s PR1391/1410, Ross Richardson’s PR1287, Sagar Thakrar’s PR1227, PR1708/1748 and the centre-sharing-overhead-budget lineage. Concurrent PR2491 (`c25a4ce22a887daf8cba8b3cfad72796752ab2ee`, ywz65) addresses a distinct actual-reader unitary embedding; its description was read and credited, not independently replayed here.

Validation: registered CPython3.12 replay passes; independent typed/primitive replay covers all56 dirty columns and all20 one/two-child phase paths; seven semantic controls and five behavioral tests pass. The source’s complete51-control canonical JSON payload reproduces as a primary-source positive control. A separate math-recursive-interfaces specialist independently derived the written proof. Optimized Git-free/read-only CPython3.14 replay and selected-record integrity pass. No selected cold replay, native/compiler admission, hosted-CI success, formal-kernel proof or new kappa is claimed.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/z4-centre-transfer-audit`.

Canonical scope and handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2488. Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0; no independent human review. Frozen inputs and selected-frontier files are unchanged.
